about: The proposed run schedule. Each run is one scheduled task that starts a conductor session on this repository; the conductor runs each step as a sub-agent that reads its state, does one kind of work, writes its state and stops. A draft: no scheduled task exists until the editor approves this file. Kept by conductor@the-ultimate-insider.
starts: after the talk on 29 October 2026, when the site turns from the deck into the record of the talk
lock: admin/runs/LOCK: written when a run opens, removed when it closes. A run that finds a lock says so first and does not start a second one.
ledger: admin/runs/index.jsonl: one row per run, with each step's outcome

steps.do: open: hold check, uncommitted changes, leak check over the tree
sweep for new public agent incidents; capture and hash the next sources in the claims register
the next card: build, gate, release; check the live site shows the new version
close: leak check over the run's diff
digest: what each step did, what is blocked and on whom, the asks for the editor
open; review any key published this week against the session that published it
re-check every captured source still says what the claim needs; flag drift
the week: what shipped, what the site still lacks, roster and schedule changes to propose
